jobs.description:
Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unseres Teams am Standort in Grödig bei Salzburg und setze dein Talent und deine Leidenschaft bei uns ein als

Project Manager Manufacturing & Design Transfer (w/m/d)

Grödig, Salzburg

Dein Beitrag

In dieser spannenden Funktion leitest Du Optimierungsprojekte innerhalb der Fertigung inkl. In/Outsourcing, begleitest die Überleitung neuer Produkte in die Serie und unterstützt beim Transfer von Produkten innerhalb des Tecan Produktionsnetzwerkes

• Koordination und Abstimmung zwischen Produktion, Entwicklung, Engineering und Projektteams

• Erstellung und Überwachung des Zeitplans für den Projekttransfer

• Planung der Produktionsvalidierung

• Einbringung produktionsrelevanter Themen ins Projekt

• Erstellung von Prozessbeschreibungen und Arbeitsanweisungen

• Risikobetrachtung des Produktionsprozesses

• Leitung von Optimierungsprojekten in Operations

• Unterstützung bei In/Outsourcing Projekten

• Unterstützung bei der Planung der Produktionslinien unter Einhaltung der Lean und 5S-Prinzipien.

Dein Profil

Wir sind nicht nur auf der Suche nach Fachwissen: Wir suchen nach Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent bei uns umsetzen.

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (Lehre mit Meister, HTL, FH oder  vergleichbar) im Bereich Mechatronik, Maschinenbau, Medizintechnik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung

• Berufserfahrung im technischen Projektmanagement, Design Transfer, Industrial Engineering oder Manufacturing Engineering.

• Erfahrung im Projektmanagement

• Grundwissen in den Bereichen Elektronik, Firmware, Optik, Mechanik

• Kenntnisse im Lean-Management von Vorteil

• Organisationstalent, analytisches Denken und hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein

• Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, SAP-Kenntnisse von Vorteil

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was macht die Arbeit bei Tecan einzigartig?

Bei Tecan arbeitest du an Technologien, die weltweit in Forschung, Diagnostik und Gesundheitswesen eingesetzt werden. Dich erwartet ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und ausgezeichneten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Freue dich auf:

• Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum

• Mitarbeit in einem international erfolgreichen Hightech-Unternehmen

• Spannende Technologien im Bereich Life Science und Medizintechnik

• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten

• Sehr gute öffentliche Anbindung und kostenlose Parkplätze

• Betriebskantine

• Umfangreiche Benefits zur Auswahl, wie JobRad, Klimaticket, Zukunfts-vorsorge, eGYM Wellpass, Lebensmittelzuschuss, Firmenveranstaltungen und vieles mehr.

Werde ein Teil von Tecan, zertifiziert als Great Place to Work!  Hier kannst du mehr über unsere Zertifizierung erfahren  Great Place to Work .

Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Für deine Bewerbung benötigen wir nur deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Foto und ohne Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse und Diplome sind optional).

Dein Ansprechpartner:

Albert Gamper (Head HR Tecan Austria)

T +43 6246 8933 277

albert.gamper@tecan.com

Aufgrund des österreichischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzes sind wir verpflichtet, das für diese Position vorgesehene monatliche  Mindestgehalt  von  EUR 3.888,53  (Einstufung laut Kollektivvertrag der Elektro- und Elektronikindustrie  auf Basis Vollzeit 38,5 Stunden/Woche ) als Verhandlungsbasis anzugeben.  Eine deutliche Überzahlung ist je nach Ausbildung, Qualifikation und Erfahrung vorgesehen.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology #DesignTransfer #Projektleitung #Operations #Validierung

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vi siete mai chiesti come le vostre abilità e background unico possono influenzare il mondo di domani? Entra a far parte del nostro team nella posizione di Grödig vicino a Salisburgo e usa il tuo talento e la tua passione con noi come

Project Manager Manufacturing & Design Transfer (f/m/d)

Grödig, Salisburgo

Il tuo contributo

In questa funzione emozionante si guida progetti di ottimizzazione all'interno della produzione incl. In/outsourcing, accompagnare il trasferimento di nuovi prodotti in serie e sostenere il trasferimento di prodotti all'interno della rete di produzione Tecan

• Coordinamento e coordinamento tra team di produzione, sviluppo, ingegneria e progetto

• Preparazione e monitoraggio del programma di trasferimento del progetto

• Pianificazione della convalida di produzione

• Introdurre argomenti rilevanti per la produzione nel progetto

• Preparazione di descrizioni di processo e istruzioni di lavoro

• Valutazione del rischio del processo di produzione

• Gestione dei progetti di ottimizzazione nelle operazioni

• Sostegno a progetti in/outsourcing

• Sostegno alla pianificazione delle linee di produzione nel rispetto dei principi Lean e 5S.

Il tuo profilo

Non siamo solo alla ricerca di competenze: stiamo cercando persone che possano mettere la loro passione e talento a lavorare con noi.

• Formazione tecnica completa (insegnamento con master, HTL, FH o simili) nel campo della meccatronica, ingegneria meccanica, tecnologia medica o una specializzazione relativa

• Esperienza professionale nella gestione dei progetti tecnici, trasferimento di design, ingegneria industriale o ingegneria manifatturiera.

• Esperienza nella gestione dei progetti

• Conoscenza di base in elettronica, firmware, ottica, meccanica

• La conoscenza della gestione magra è un vantaggio

• Talenti organizzativi, pensiero analitico e consapevolezza di alta qualità

• Buona SM Conoscenza degli uffici, conoscenza SAP dei vantaggi

• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese

Cosa rende il lavoro a Tecan unico?

A Tecan, lavori sulle tecnologie utilizzate nella ricerca, nella diagnostica e nella sanità in tutto il mondo. Si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro moderno con un sacco di strada creativa e eccellenti opportunità di sviluppo.

Attendere con ansia:

• Una posizione responsabile con molto spazio per manovra

• Lavorare in un'azienda high-tech di successo internazionale

• Tecnologie emozionanti nel campo della scienza della vita e della tecnologia medica

• Possibilità di formazione e sviluppo individuali

• Orari di lavoro flessibili e opzioni per l'ufficio domestico

• Ottimo accesso pubblico e parcheggio gratuito

• Servizio mensa

• Ampia gamma di vantaggi tra cui scegliere, come JobRad, ticket climatici, fornitura futura, eGYM Wellpass, sussidio alimentare, eventi aziendali e molto altro ancora.

Diventa parte di Tecan, certificato come Grande Luogo di Lavoro! Qui puoi saperne di più sulla nostra certificazione Great Place to Work.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online. Per la vostra applicazione, abbiamo solo bisogno del vostro CV (senza foto e senza lettere di motivazione, certificati e diplomi sono facoltativi).

La persona di contatto:

Albert Gamper (Head HR Tecan Austria)

T +43 6246 8933 277

albert.gamper@tecan.com

A causa della legge austriaca sulla parità di trattamento, siamo tenuti a specificare lo stipendio minimo mensile di EUR 3.888.53 (classificazione secondo l'accordo collettivo dell'industria elettrica ed elettronica su una base a tempo pieno di 38.5 ore/settimana) come base per i negoziati. Si prevede un pagamento eccessivo significativo a seconda dell'istruzione, delle qualifiche e dell'esperienza.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology #DesignTransfer #project management #Operations #Validation

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - la fiducia, i più alti standard e l'ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento a lavorare.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Avez-vous déjà demandé comment vos compétences et vos antécédents uniques peuvent affecter le monde de demain? Faites partie de notre équipe à l'emplacement de Grödig près de Salzbourg et utilisez votre talent et votre passion avec nous comme

Gestionnaire de projet Fabrication et transfert de conception (f/m/d)

Grödig, Salzbourg

Votre contribution

Dans cette fonction passionnante vous dirigez des projets d'optimisation dans la production incl. Accompagner le transfert de nouveaux produits en série et soutenir le transfert de produits au sein du réseau de production Tecan

• Coordination et coordination entre les équipes de production, de développement, d'ingénierie et de projet

• Préparation et suivi du calendrier de transfert du projet

• Planification de la validation de la production

• Introduction de sujets pertinents pour la production dans le projet

• Préparation des descriptions de processus et des instructions de travail

• Évaluation des risques du processus de production

• Gestion des projets d'optimisation dans les opérations

• Appui aux projets d ' externalisation

• Appui à la planification des lignes de production conformément aux principes Lean et 5S.

Votre profil

Nous ne cherchons pas seulement l'expertise : nous cherchons des gens qui peuvent mettre leur passion et leur talent à notre service.

• Formation technique complète (enseignement avec master, HTL, FH ou similaire) dans le domaine de la mécatronique, de l'ingénierie mécanique, de la technologie médicale ou d'une spécialisation connexe

• Expérience professionnelle en gestion de projet technique, transfert de conception, ingénierie industrielle ou ingénierie de fabrication.

• Expérience en gestion de projet

• Connaissances de base en électronique, firmware, optique, mécanique

• La connaissance de la gestion maigre est un avantage

• Compétences organisationnelles, réflexion analytique et sensibilisation de haute qualité

• Bonne EM Connaissance des bureaux, connaissance SAP des avantages

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais

Qu'est-ce qui rend le travail à Tecan unique?

Chez Tecan, vous travaillez sur les technologies utilisées dans la recherche, le diagnostic et les soins de santé dans le monde entier. Vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement de travail moderne avec beaucoup de latitude créative et d'excellentes opportunités de développement.

Nous attendons avec impatience :

• Une position responsable avec beaucoup de marge de manoeuvre

• Travailler dans une entreprise de haute technologie ayant un succès international

• Technologies passionnantes dans le domaine des sciences de la vie et des technologies médicales

• Possibilités individuelles de formation et de perfectionnement

• Horaires de travail flexibles et options de bureau à domicile

• Très bon accès public et parking gratuit

• Service cantine

• De nombreux avantages à choisir, comme JobRad, billet climat, provision future, eGYM Wellpass, subvention alimentaire, événements corporatifs et bien plus encore.

Devenez membre de Tecan, certifié Great Place to Work! Ici vous pouvez en savoir plus sur notre certification Great Place to Work.

Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature en ligne. Pour votre candidature, nous n'avons besoin que de votre CV (sans photo et sans lettres de motivation, les certificats et diplômes sont facultatifs).

Votre personne-ressource:

Albert Gamper (chef HR Tecan Autriche)

T +43 6246 8933 277

Albert.gamper@tecan.com

En raison de la loi autrichienne sur l'égalité de traitement, nous sommes tenus de préciser le salaire mensuel minimum de 3 888,53 EUR (classification selon la convention collective de l'industrie électrique et électronique à temps plein de 38,5 heures/semaine) comme base de négociation. Un trop-payé important est envisagé en fonction de l'éducation, des qualifications et de l'expérience.

#sciences de la vie #santé #automation #médicaldevice #biologie #biotechnologie #DesignTransfert #gestion de projet #Opérations #Validation

Notre but.

Chez Tecan, nous sommes déterminés à améliorer la vie et la santé des gens. Nous le faisons en responsabilisant nos clients à étendre l'innovation en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, depuis les sciences de la vie jusqu'à la clinique. Nous collaborons avec nos clients depuis l'innovation en phase initiale jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de projets et au-delà. Nous fournissons les produits, services et solutions qui rendent les processus de laboratoire et les procédures médicales précis, reproductibles et conformes.

Restez unique et faites-le compter.

Nos valeurs - la confiance, les normes les plus élevées et l'ambition - sont les pierres angulaires de notre entreprise et constituent le cadre de la culture de Tecan. Nous favorisons un environnement positif et autonomisant où nos atouts les plus rares, nos employés uniques, peuvent grandir et apporter leur passion et leur talent au travail.

jobs.description:
Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unseres Teams am Standort in Grödig bei Salzburg und setze dein Talent und deine Leidenschaft bei uns ein als

Manufacturing Engineer Electronics (w/m/d)

Grödig, Salzburg

Dein Beitrag

In dieser spannenden Funktion analysierst du technische Herausforderungen an elektronischen Baugruppen und generierst daraus Vorschläge zur Qualitätsverbesserung für bestehende und neue Produkte.

• Analyse von fehlerbehafteten Komponenten, wie z.B. Leiterplatten, Sensoren, Motoren

• Erarbeitung von Lösungsvorschlägen zur Behebung des Problems und Umsetzung diese Lösungen mit anderen Abteilungen

• Aufbau und Wartung von Testequipment

• Mitarbeit im Änderungswesen und Projekten

• Ansprechpartner im Elektronikbereich für andere Abteilungen

• Erstellung und Pflege der Prozessdokumentation

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung, Qualität, Einkauf, Produktion und internationalen Lieferanten

• Durchführung technischer Schulungen für Produktionsmitarbeitende

Dein Profil

Wir sind nicht nur auf der Suche nach Fachwissen: Wir suchen nach Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent bei uns umsetzen.

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in Elektronik (Lehre oder HTL), oder Studium (mit Schwerpunkt Elektronik)

• Erste bis mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Elektronik, Manufacturing Engineering oder Produktqualität

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Elektronik-CAD-Systemen (z. B. Altium Designer) ist von Vorteil

• Analytisches Denken, strukturierte und selbständige Arbeitsweise

• Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, SAP-Kenntnisse sowie Programmierkenntnisse von Vorteil

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unseres Teams am Standort in Grödig bei Salzburg und setze dein Talent und deine Leidenschaft bei uns ein als

Manufacturing Engineer (w/m/d)

Grödig, Salzburg

Dein Beitrag

In dieser abwechslungsreichen Position analysierst du technische Herausforderungen in der Produktion und generierst daraus Vorschläge zur Qualitätsverbesserung für bestehende und neue Produkte. Dabei fungierst du als Bindeglied zwischen Entwicklung und Produktion.

Dabei gehören insbesondere folgende Aufgaben zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich:

• Analyse von fehlerbehafteten Komponenten

• Erarbeitung von Lösungsvorschlägen zur Behebung des Problems und Umsetzung diese Lösungen mit anderen Abteilungen

• Aufbau und Wartung von Testequipment

• Freigabetests von geänderten Baugruppen in der Produktion

• Unterstützung bei Entwicklungs- und Transferprojekten

• Erstellung von Prozessdokumentation

• Durchführung technischer Schulungen für Produktionsmitarbeitende

• Technische Unterstützung bei Lieferantenqualifizierungen sowie Analyse und Bearbeitung elektronikspezifischer Qualitätsprobleme gemeinsam mit Einkauf und Lieferanten.

Dein Profil

Wir sind nicht nur auf der Suche nach Fachwissen: Wir suchen nach Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent bei uns umsetzen.

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. abgeschlossene technische Lehre, evtl. mit Meister, HTL, FH) im Bereich Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Medizintechnik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung

• Einige Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem produzierenden Unternehmen

• Erfahrung im Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering oder in der Prozessoptimierung von Vorteil

• Gute Kenntnisse von Produktions- und Fertigungsprozessen

• Technisches Verständnis in Mechanik sowie Grundkenntnisse in Elektronik, Optik und idealerweise Firmware

• Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

• Kommunikationsstärke sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen

• Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse; SAP-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was macht die Arbeit bei Tecan einzigartig?

Bei Tecan arbeitest du an Technologien, die weltweit in Forschung, Diagnostik und Gesundheitswesen eingesetzt werden. Dich erwartet ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und ausgezeichneten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Freue dich auf:

• Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum

• Mitarbeit in einem international erfolgreichen Hightech-Unternehmen

• Spannende Technologien im Bereich Life Science und Medizintechnik

• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten

• Sehr gute öffentliche Anbindung und kostenlose Parkplätze

• Betriebskantine

• Umfangreiche Benefits zur Auswahl, wie JobRad, Klimaticket, Zukunftsvorsorge, eGYM Wellpass, Lebensmittelzuschuss, Firmenveranstaltungen und vieles mehr.

Werde ein Teil von Tecan, zertifiziert als Great Place to Work! Hier kannst du mehr über unsere Zertifizierung erfahren Great Place to Work .

Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Für deine Bewerbung benötigen wir nur deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Foto und ohne Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse und Diplome sind optional).

Dein Ansprechpartner:

Albert Gamper (Head HR Tecan Austria)

T +43 6246 8933 277

albert.gamper@tecan.com

Aufgrund des österreichischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzes sind wir verpflichtet, das für diese Position vorgesehene monatliche Mindestgehalt von EUR 3.449,08 (Einstufung laut Kollektivvertrag der Elektro- und Elektronikindustrie auf Basis Vollzeit 38,5 Stunden/Woche ) als Verhandlungsbasis anzugeben. Eine deutliche Überzahlung ist je nach Ausbildung, Qualifikation und Erfahrung vorgesehen.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology #Manufacturing #Engineering

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

jobs.description:
Human Resources Intern

Location: Morrisville, North Carolina

Position Summary

Tecan is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Human Resources Intern to join our People & Organization team in Morrisville, NC. This internship provides a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience while supporting the day-to-day operations of the HR team and contributing to projects that enhance the employee experience and organizational effectiveness.

Working alongside members of the People & Organization team, the intern will support a variety of HR activities and projects while gaining exposure to multiple Human Resources disciplines based on business priorities and organizational needs. This opportunity is ideal for students or individuals interested in exploring careers in Human Resources, business administration, or people management while developing practical business skills in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Example Projects

Depending on business priorities during the internship, opportunities may include:

• Supporting onboarding and new hire orientation activities

• Assisting with employee records management and HR documentation

• Creating and maintaining HR templates, forms, and electronic documents

• Supporting interview scheduling and recruiting coordination

• Assisting with employee engagement and recognition initiatives

• Preparing HR reports, presentations, and process documentation

Essential Responsibilities

Human Resources Operations

• Assist with onboarding and new hire orientation activities.

• Support employee record maintenance while ensuring confidentiality of sensitive information.

• Assist with HR data entry, audits, and document management.

• Prepare HR reports, spreadsheets, and presentations as needed.

• Assist with creating and maintaining HR templates, forms, process documentation, and fillable electronic forms.

Talent Acquisition

• Assist with interview scheduling and candidate communications.

• Coordinate interview logistics and recruiting activities.

• Participate in résumé screening and other recruitment support activities.

Employee Engagement

• Assist with employee engagement initiatives and recognition programs.

• Support employee events, wellness activities, and community engagement initiatives.

• Help prepare communications and presentation materials for HR activities.

Qualifications

Required

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in:

• Human Resources

• Business Administration

• Management

• Psychology

• Organizational Leadership

• Or a related field

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

Preferred

• Previous internship, administrative, or customer service experience.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or HR information systems.

• Interest in Human Resources, talent acquisition, employee engagement, or organizational development.

Competencies

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills

• Organization and attention to detail

• Professionalism and integrity

• Learning agility

• Initiative

• Collaboration and teamwork

• Customer service orientation

• Adaptability

• Continuous improvement mindset

Learning Opportunities

This internship is designed to provide a balance of meaningful project work and hands-on learning opportunities. While supporting the day-to-day activities of the People & Organization team, the selected candidate will gain exposure to HR operations, onboarding, talent acquisition, employee engagement, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration. The specific projects will vary based on business needs during the internship, providing practical experience and insight into how Human Resources supports organizational success.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work in an office environment.

• Ability to sit, stand, and use a computer for extended periods.

• Occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.

Why Join Tecan?

At Tecan, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects that enhance the employee experience while gaining exposure to multiple areas of Human Resources. Working alongside experienced HR professionals, you'll develop practical business skills, strengthen your communication and organizational abilities, and gain valuable experience supporting people initiatives in a global life sciences organization.

Salary Range: $21.00–$24.00 per hour

(Salary will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with industry data.)

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Risorse umane Intern

Posizione: Morrisville, North Carolina

Posizione Sommario

Tecan sta cercando un Interno di Risorse Umane motivato e orientato al dettaglio per unirsi al nostro team People & Organization a Morrisville, NC. Questo stage offre un'opportunità unica per acquisire esperienza pratica mentre supporta le operazioni quotidiane del team HR e contribuisce a progetti che migliorano l'esperienza dei dipendenti e l'efficacia organizzativa.

Lavorando insieme ai membri del team People & Organization, lo stage sosterrà una varietà di attività e progetti HR, mentre acquisirà l'esposizione a più discipline di risorse umane basate sulle priorità aziendali e sulle esigenze organizzative. Questa opportunità è ideale per gli studenti o gli individui interessati ad esplorare le carriere in Risorse Umane, amministrazione aziendale, o la gestione delle persone, sviluppando competenze pratiche di business in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce.

Esempio di progetti

A seconda delle priorità aziendali durante lo stage, le opportunità possono includere:

• Sostenere le attività di onboard e di nolo

• Assistere con la gestione dei record dei dipendenti e la documentazione HR

• Creazione e mantenimento di modelli HR, forme e documenti elettronici

• Sostegno alla programmazione e al coordinamento di reclutamento

• Assistere con iniziative di coinvolgimento e riconoscimento dei dipendenti

• Preparazione di report HR, presentazioni e documentazione di processo

Responsabilità essenziali

Operazioni di risorse umane

• Assistere a bordo e nuove attività di orientamento al noleggio.

• Supporta la manutenzione dei record dei dipendenti, assicurando la riservatezza delle informazioni sensibili.

• Assistere con la voce dei dati HR, audit e gestione dei documenti.

• Preparare rapporti HR, fogli di calcolo e presentazioni come necessario.

• Assistere con la creazione e il mantenimento di modelli HR, moduli, documentazione di processo e moduli elettronici riempibili.

Acquisizione di talenti

• Assistere con la programmazione delle interviste e le comunicazioni dei candidati.

• Coordinare l'intervista logistica e le attività di reclutamento.

• Partecipa alle attività di screening del curriculum e di altre attività di supporto al reclutamento.

Impegno dei dipendenti

• Assistere con iniziative di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti e programmi di riconoscimento.

• Sostenere gli eventi dei dipendenti, le attività di benessere e le iniziative di impegno della comunità.

• Aiuta a preparare comunicazioni e materiali di presentazione per le attività HR.

Qualifiche

Obbligo

Attualmente perseguire una laurea o master in:

• Risorse umane

• Amministrazione aziendale

• Gestione

• Psicologia

• Leadership organizzativa

• O un campo correlato

• Forte capacità organizzative e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale.

• Proficienza con Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel, Word e PowerPoint.

• Capacità di gestire più priorità e rispettare le scadenze.

• Capacità di gestire informazioni riservate con professionalità e discrezione.

Preferito

• Esperienza precedente di stage, amministrazione o servizio clienti.

• Familiarità con i sistemi informativi Microsoft Teams, SharePoint o HR.

• Interessi in Risorse Umane, acquisizione di talenti, coinvolgimento dei dipendenti o sviluppo organizzativo.

Competenze

I candidati di successo dimostreranno:

• Forte capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione

• Organizzazione e attenzione ai dettagli

• Professionalità e integrità

• Agilità di apprendimento

• Iniziativa

• Collaborazione e lavoro di squadra

• Servizio clienti orientamento

• Adaptability

• Mente di miglioramento continuo

Opportunità di apprendimento

What You Bring

• Strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail
• Excellent written, verbal, and professional communication abilities
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
• Strong customer service orientation with a collaborative, solution-focused mindset
• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
• High level of initiative, accountability, and adaptability

• Ability to learn and understand complex scientific products, software, and workflows

• Familiarity with laboratory automation, instrumentation, or life sciences products preferred

• Experience supporting capital equipment or technical product quotations

descriptionByLocale.en:
Bring your technical expertise, attention to detail, and customer-focused mindset to a team supporting innovative laboratory automation solutions across the life sciences industry.

Senior Technical Sales Support Coordinator

Hybrid|Full-Time

Morrisville, NC 27560

Make an Impact With Our Team

Are you passionate about supporting technical sales teams and delivering accurate, customer-focused solutions in a fast-paced scientific environment? We are seeking a Senior Technical Sales Support Coordinator to play a key role in supporting our commercial organization through quotation development, technical feasibility review, pricing coordination, and cross-functional communication.

In this role, you will partner closely with Sales, Applications, Service, and Operations teams to ensure customers receive timely, technically accurate, and commercially compliant quotations and proposals. You will serve as a critical resource for both internal stakeholders and customers throughout the sales support process.

If you enjoy solving problems, managing multiple priorities, and supporting scientific sales operations with precision and professionalism, we encourage you to apply.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Review quotation requests, bids, and proposals for technical feasibility, product compatibility, and commercial accuracy
• Generate and process customer quotations using internal CRM and ERP systems
• Support Sales Representatives and customers with product questions, pricing inquiries, and quotation-related communication
• Coordinate with internal subject matter experts to develop customer-specific pricing structures and configurations
• Ensure proper pricing, discounts, approvals, and compliance standards are applied to all quotations
• Maintain and support field-based quoting tools and related sales support resources
• Troubleshoot and assist users with CRM and ERP system functionality related to quoting and order processing
• Track quotation turnaround times and maintain accurate documentation throughout the quote lifecycle
• Participate in customer communication programs including order acknowledgments and project coordination activities
• Maintain territory-related sales data, spreadsheets, reporting tools, and mapping resources
• Collaborate with Sales, Applications, Service, and Finance teams to resolve customer and operational issues efficiently
• Provide training and guidance to team members regarding quoting processes, systems, and best practices
• Serve as an escalation point for internal and external inquiries prior to management involvement
• Contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives within the commercial support organization
• Ensure compliance with all company policies, quality standards, and safety requirements

What You Bring

• Strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail
• Excellent written, verbal, and professional communication abilities
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
• Strong customer service orientation with a collaborative, solution-focused mindset
• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
• High level of initiative, accountability, and adaptability
• Professional phone and customer communication etiquette
• Ability to learn and understand complex scientific products, software, and workflows
• Strong commitment to quality, accuracy, and operational excellence

Your Background

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Business, Biotechnology, or related field preferred
• 2+ years of experience supporting technical sales, laboratory instrumentation, automation, or scientific operations environments preferred
• Experience with CRM, ERP, or quotation management systems required
• Familiarity with laboratory automation, instrumentation, or life sciences products preferred
• Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel
• Experience working in customer-facing or sales support roles strongly preferred

Nice to Have

• Experience supporting capital equipment or technical product quotations
• Familiarity with SAP CRM, SAP ERP, or related enterprise systems
• Experience coordinating customer-specific pricing or contract documentation
• Background supporting field sales teams in scientific or healthcare industries
• Experience training users on internal systems or workflows
• Knowledge of laboratory automation or liquid handling technologies

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
• Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid time off and company holidays
• Professional development and career growth opportunities
• Collaborative and team-oriented culture
• Opportunity to support innovative technologies advancing scientific discovery

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Bringen Sie Ihre technische Expertise, Ihre Liebe zum Detail und Ihre kundenorientierte Denkweise in ein Team ein, das innovative Laborautomationslösungen in der Life-Science-Branche unterstützt.

Senior Technical Sales Support Koordinator

Hybrid | Vollzeit

Morrisville, NC 27560

Machen Sie eine Wirkung mit unserem Team

Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, technische Vertriebsteams zu unterstützen und präzise, kundenorientierte Lösungen in einem schnelllebigen wissenschaftlichen Umfeld zu liefern? Wir suchen einen Senior Technical Sales Support Coordinator, der eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Unterstützung unserer kommerziellen Organisation durch Angebotsentwicklung, technische Machbarkeitsprüfung, Preiskoordination und funktionsübergreifende Kommunikation spielt.

In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie eng mit Vertriebs-, Anwendungs-, Service- und Betriebsteams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Kunden zeitnahe, technisch korrekte und kommerziell konforme Angebote und Vorschläge erhalten. Sie werden als eine wichtige Ressource für interne Stakeholder und Kunden während des gesamten Vertriebs-Support-Prozesses dienen.

Wenn Sie gerne Probleme lösen, mehrere Prioritäten verwalten und den wissenschaftlichen Vertrieb mit Präzision und Professionalität unterstützen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben.

Wie werden Sie eine Wirkung erzielen?

• Überprüfung von Angebotsanfragen, Angeboten und Vorschlägen auf technische Machbarkeit, Produktkompatibilität und kommerzielle Genauigkeit
• Generieren und verarbeiten Sie Kundenangebote mit internen CRM- und ERP-Systemen
• Unterstützen Sie Vertriebsmitarbeiter und Kunden bei Produktfragen, Preisanfragen und angebotsbezogener Kommunikation
• Koordination mit internen Fachexperten zur Entwicklung kundenspezifischer Preisstrukturen und -konfigurationen
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass angemessene Preise, Rabatte, Genehmigungen und Compliance-Standards auf alle Angebote angewendet werden
• Pflegen und unterstützen Sie feldbasierte Zitiertools und damit verbundene Vertriebsunterstützungsressourcen
• Beheben und Unterstützen von Benutzern mit CRM- und ERP-Systemfunktionen im Zusammenhang mit Angeboten und Auftragsverarbeitung
• Verfolgen Sie die Durchlaufzeit von Angeboten und pflegen Sie eine genaue Dokumentation während des gesamten Angebotslebenszyklus
• Teilnahme an Kundenkommunikationsprogrammen einschließlich Auftragsbestätigungen und Projektkoordinationsaktivitäten
• Pflegen Sie gebietsbezogene Verkaufsdaten, Tabellenkalkulationen, Berichtstools und Abbildungsressourcen
• Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebs-, Anwendungs-, Service- und Finanzteams, um Kunden- und Betriebsprobleme effizient zu lösen
• Schulungen und Anleitungen für Teammitglieder zum Zitieren von Prozessen, Systemen und Best Practices
• Als Eskalationspunkt für interne und externe Anfragen vor der Beteiligung des Managements dienen
• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen innerhalb der kommerziellen Unterstützungsorganisation
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung aller Unternehmensrichtlinien, Qualitätsstandards und Sicherheitsanforderungen

Was du mitbringst

• Starke Organisations- und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten mit außergewöhnlicher Liebe zum Detail
• Hervorragende schriftliche, verbale und professionelle Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten und Fristen in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu verwalten
• Starke Kundenorientierung mit kollaborativem, lösungsorientiertem Mindset
• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig effektiv in einer Teamumgebung beizutragen
• Starke analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten
• Hohes Maß an Initiative, Verantwortlichkeit und Anpassungsfähigkeit
• Professionelle Telefon- und Kundenkommunikationsetikette
• Fähigkeit, komplexe wissenschaftliche Produkte, Software und Workflows zu lernen und zu verstehen
• Starkes Engagement für Qualität, Genauigkeit und operative Exzellenz

Dein Hintergrund

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Life Sciences, Business, Biotechnologie oder verwandten Bereichen bevorzugt
• 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von technischen Vertriebs-, Laborinstrumentierungs-, Automatisierungs- oder wissenschaftlichen Betriebsumgebungen
• Erfahrung mit CRM-, ERP- oder Angebotsmanagementsystemen erforderlich
• Vertrautheit mit Laborautomation, Instrumentierung oder bevorzugten Life-Science-Produkten
• Starke Kenntnisse mit Microsoft Office Suite, insbesondere Excel
• Erfahrung in kundenorientierten oder Sales Support Rollen stark bevorzugt

Nizza zu haben

• Erfahrung mit der Unterstützung von Investitionsgütern oder technischen Produktangeboten
• Vertrautheit mit SAP CRM, SAP ERP oder verwandten Unternehmenssystemen
• Erfahrung in der Koordination kundenspezifischer Preisgestaltung oder Vertragsdokumentation
• Hintergrund zur Unterstützung von Außendienstteams in der Wissenschafts- oder Gesundheitsbranche
• Erleben Sie das Training von Benutzern zu internen Systemen oder Workflows
• Kenntnisse in Laborautomation oder Liquid Handling Technologien

Was wir anbieten

• Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung und umfassendes Leistungspaket
• Medizinische, zahnärztliche und Vision Abdeckung
• 401 (k) mit Company Match
• Bezahlte Freizeit und Firmenurlaub
• Berufliche Entwicklung und berufliche Wachstumschancen
• Kollaborative und teamorientierte Kultur
• Möglichkeit zur Unterstützung innovativer Technologien zur Förderung wissenschaftlicher Entdeckungen

Unser Ziel.

Bei Tecan sind wir bestrebt, das Leben und die Gesundheit der Menschen zu verbessern. Wir tun dies, indem wir unsere Kunden in die Lage versetzen, Gesundheitsinnovationen weltweit von der Biowissenschaft bis zur Klinik zu skalieren. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Kunden von der Frühphase der Innovation bis zur Projektumsetzung und darüber hinaus zusammen. Wir liefern die Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Lösungen, die Laborprozesse und medizinische Verfahren präzise, reproduzierbar und konform machen.

Bleib einzigartig und lass es zählen.

Unsere Werte - Vertrauen, höchste Standards und Ehrgeiz - sind die Eckpfeiler unseres Geschäfts und bilden den Rahmen für die Kultur von Tecan. Wir fördern ein positives und ermächtigendes Umfeld, in dem unsere seltensten Vermögenswerte, unsere einzigartigen Mitarbeiter, wachsen und ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent einbringen können.

Coordonnateur principal du soutien technique aux ventes

Hybride à plein temps

Morrisville, NC 27560

Faites un impact avec notre équipe

Êtes-vous passionné par le soutien des équipes techniques de vente et la fourniture de solutions précises et axées sur le client dans un environnement scientifique à rythme rapide? Nous cherchons un coordonnateur principal du soutien technique aux ventes pour jouer un rôle clé dans le soutien de notre organisation commerciale par l'élaboration de devis, l'examen de faisabilité technique, la coordination des prix et la communication interfonctionnelle.

Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Ventes, Applications, Service et Opérations pour s'assurer que les clients reçoivent en temps opportun des devis et des propositions techniquement exacts et conformes au marché. Vous serez une ressource essentielle pour les intervenants internes et les clients tout au long du processus de soutien des ventes.

Si vous aimez résoudre des problèmes, gérer plusieurs priorités et soutenir les opérations de vente scientifiques avec précision et professionnalisme, nous vous encourageons à postuler.

Comment allez - vous avoir un impact?

• Examiner les demandes de devis, les soumissions et les propositions de faisabilité technique, de compatibilité avec les produits et d'exactitude commerciale
• Générer et traiter les devis clients à l'aide de systèmes internes CRM et ERP
• Soutenir les représentants des ventes et les clients avec des questions sur les produits, les demandes de prix et la communication liée aux prix
• Coordonner avec des experts internes en la matière l'élaboration de structures et de configurations de tarification spécifiques à la clientèle
• Veiller à ce que les prix, les rabais, les approbations et les normes de conformité soient appliqués à tous les devis
• Maintenir et appuyer les outils de citation sur le terrain et les ressources connexes d ' appui aux ventes
• Dépanner et aider les utilisateurs avec les fonctionnalités du système CRM et ERP liées à la citation et au traitement des commandes
• Suivre les temps d'exécution des citations et maintenir une documentation précise tout au long du cycle de vie des citations
• Participer à des programmes de communication avec les clients, y compris des reconnaissances de commande et des activités de coordination de projet
• Tenir à jour les données sur les ventes, les feuilles de calcul, les outils de rapport et les ressources cartographiques
• Collaborer avec les équipes des ventes, des applications, du service et des finances pour résoudre efficacement les problèmes des clients et des opérations
• Offrir une formation et des conseils aux membres de l'équipe concernant les processus, les systèmes et les pratiques exemplaires
• Servir de point d'escalade pour les enquêtes internes et externes avant la participation de la direction
• Contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration continue des processus au sein de l'organisme de soutien commercial
• Assurer le respect de toutes les politiques, normes de qualité et exigences de sécurité de l'entreprise

Ce que vous apportez

• Fortes compétences organisationnelles et de gestion du temps avec une attention exceptionnelle aux détails
• Excellente capacité de communication écrite, verbale et professionnelle
• Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et délais dans un environnement rapide
• Orientation forte du service à la clientèle avec un état d'esprit collaboratif axé sur la solution
• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante tout en contribuant efficacement dans un environnement d'équipe
• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes
• Niveau élevé d'initiative, de responsabilité et d'adaptabilité
• Étiquette professionnelle de communication téléphonique et client
• Capacité d'apprendre et de comprendre des produits scientifiques complexes, des logiciels et des flux de travail
• Engagement ferme envers la qualité, l'exactitude et l'excellence opérationnelle

Vos antécédents

• Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, affaires, biotechnologie ou domaine connexe préféré
• 2+ ans d'expérience dans des environnements de vente technique, d'instrumentation de laboratoire, d'automatisation ou d'opérations scientifiques préférés
• Expérience requise avec les systèmes de gestion CRM, ERP ou de cotation
• Familiarité avec les produits d'automatisation de laboratoire, d'instrumentation ou de sciences de la vie préférés
• Forte compétence avec Microsoft Office Suite, en particulier Excel
• Expérience dans les rôles de soutien à la clientèle ou aux ventes fortement préféré

Sympa d'avoir

• Expérience d'appui aux biens d'équipement ou aux prix de produits techniques
• Familiarité avec SAP CRM, SAP ERP ou les systèmes d'entreprise connexes
• Expérience en matière de coordination des prix ou de la documentation contractuelle
• Contexte appuyant les équipes de vente sur le terrain dans les industries scientifiques ou de la santé
• Expérience de la formation des utilisateurs sur les systèmes internes ou les flux de travail
• Connaissance des techniques d'automatisation de laboratoire ou de manipulation des liquides

Ce que nous offrons

• Compétitivité et ensemble d'avantages globaux
• Couverture médicale, dentaire et visuelle
• 401(k) avec match d'entreprise
• Congé payé et jours fériés de l'entreprise
• Développement professionnel et perspectives de carrière
• Culture collaborative et axée sur l'équipe
• Possibilité d'appuyer des technologies innovantes favorisant la découverte scientifique

Notre but.

Chez Tecan, nous sommes déterminés à améliorer la vie et la santé des gens. Nous le faisons en responsabilisant nos clients à étendre l'innovation en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, depuis les sciences de la vie jusqu'à la clinique. Nous collaborons avec nos clients depuis l'innovation en phase initiale jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de projets et au-delà. Nous fournissons les produits, services et solutions qui rendent les processus de laboratoire et les procédures médicales précis, reproductibles et conformes.

Restez unique et faites-le compter.

Nos valeurs - la confiance, les normes les plus élevées et l'ambition - sont les pierres angulaires de notre entreprise et constituent le cadre de la culture de Tecan. Nous favorisons un environnement positif et autonomisant où nos atouts les plus rares, nos employés uniques, peuvent grandir et apporter leur passion et leur talent au travail.

•
 Achieves sales plan for assigned territory.

•
 Develops and maintains a high level of consultative sales skills, product and application methodology knowledge with associated features and benefits required to convert customer needs to sales.

 Works regularly with the Service organization to insure customer satisfaction and to realize revenue on a predictable and timely manner.

 Completes all reports and customer information effectively and consistently as deemed necessary by the company

jobs.title: Trainee in Marketing
jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Are you passionate about strategic marketing, cross-functional collaboration, and making a real impact in a global organization? Tecan, a publicly listed leader in life sciences, is seeking a Marketing Trainee for our Partnering Business Division to drive brand awareness, generate demand, and support sales through innovative marketing initiatives. Join our Marketing Department in Partnering Business and bring your creativity, analytical mindset, and customer-centric approach to work.

Trainee in Marketing – Fix-Term, 6 months (100%)

Männedorf, Zurich

Your contribution
 In this exciting and hands-on role, you will have the opportunity to:

• Support integrated and account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives to engage targeted customers and generate qualified leads

• Assist in setting up, monitoring, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns

• Coordinate campaign assets such as emails, landing pages, digital ads, and webinars, ensuring consistency across touch points

• Track, analyze and report campaign performance, ensuring alignment with key performance indicators (KPIs)

• Contribute to the development of marketing dashboards and reporting tools to visualize performance metrics and insights

• Maintain and improve CRM data quality for accurate segmentation and lead tracking

• Contribute to brand awareness activities, including digital content creation, market insights and competitor research

• Support marketing-related events and internal communication activities

• Collaborate closely with Product Management, Sales, Digital Marketing, and Branding teams

Männedorf, Zürich or Barcelona, Spain

Your contribution

As Head of Information Security, you will lead and develop Tecan’s IT (Cyber) Security domain, ensuring robust protection against internal and external threats. You’ll drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of IT security strategies, guidelines, and solutions. Collaborating across the business, you’ll define and govern IT security measures, support all IT teams, and partner with external stakeholders.

Responsibilities

• Define, own and continuously evolve Tecan's global Information Security and Cyber Security strategy aligned with business objectives.

• Lead and develop the Information Security organization, including people leadership, budgeting, vendor management and capability development.

• Own the corporate Information Security Management System (ISMS) and maintain ISO 27001 certification across the organization.

• Establish enterprise-wide cyber risk management, security governance, policies, standards and security metrics.

• Advise the CIO, executive leadership and senior stakeholders on cyber risks, security strategy and regulatory requirements.

• Drive security architecture and ensure security-by-design across infrastructure, cloud platforms, applications and digital transformation initiatives.

• Oversee Security Operations, Threat Detection, Incident Response, Vulnerability Management and Cyber Resilience capabilities.

• Own Identity & Access Management, Privileged Access Management and Zero Trust initiatives.

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations and standards (ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR, CRA and industry requirements).

• Define the security roadmap and investment portfolio while balancing business enablement and cyber risk.

• Manage strategic relationships with external partners, auditors and security service providers.

• Promote a strong security culture through awareness, governance and executive engagement.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security or related field.

• 10+ years of Information Security experience, including leadership responsibilities.

• Proven experience leading enterprise Information Security organizations within an international environment.

• Demonstrated experience establishing and operating ISO 27001 certified Information Security Management Systems (ISMS).

• Strong understanding of enterprise cyber risk management and governance.

• Experience presenting security strategy and risk to executive management and Boards.

• Deep knowledge of cloud security (Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365), Identity & Access Management and Zero Trust architectures.

• Experience managing Security Operations, Incident Response and Cyber Crisis Management.

• Familiarity with regulatory frameworks including ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR, CIS Controls, NIST CSF and Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

• Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CRISC are highly desirable.

• Fluent English required; German is an advantage.

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our R&D team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Machine Learning Engineer (Fix Term – 12 months) 100%

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will play a key role in integrating laboratory automation into computational pipelines, delivering robust, user-friendly solutions that accelerate scientific innovation. You’ll contribute to projects ranging from automation UX enhancement and anomaly detection to predictive maintenance and Physical AI. Initially, you’ll join a pioneering project to develop an AI-powered lab assistant capable of designing and executing automated experiments on Tecan liquid handling robots.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and encapsulate automation interfaces for liquid handlers and detection instruments using modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Python).

• Develop and support SDKs (Python, C#, Go) for programmatic access by AI, data science, and scientific users.

• Ensure APIs and integration layers are robust, well-documented, and optimized for developer experience.

• Design translation layers between experimental workflows and Tecan’s proprietary scripting language for seamless robot motion planning.

• Work with protocol datasets and leverage large language models or code-generation models to produce reliable and safe automation scripts.

• Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver robust, user-friendly solutions for laboratory automation, including building AI algorithms and features to improve product UX.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Currently pursuing or completed a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Robotics, AI/ML, or a related field.

• Strong foundation in Python programming.

• Comfortable working with transformer-based models (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).

• Familiarity with robotics control, automation, or motion planning; interest in laboratory automation and biotech.

• Experience with laboratory automation systems is a plus.

• Knowledge of C++ and/or C# and understanding of lab protocols is nice to have.

• English required; German is a plus.

• Strong team player with excellent communication and technical presentation skills.

• Brings passion and talent to the role, with the ability to work in a multidisciplinary team and iterate quickly.

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. You are the key liaison for the customers to internal counterparts in R&D, Operations, Service, Quality and Regulatory. • Oversee operational life cycle management of existing products, ensuring customer satisfaction, compliance, documentation, and financial performance in close collaboration with the dedicated Sales counterpart

• Lead key client meetings like quarterly business reviews, quality reviews as well as internal product care meetings, steering meetings, with regular attendance of executives

• Guide customers through design and regulatory changes and global or local events impacting their business (e.g. tariffs)

• Maintain and manage budget, sales, and forecasts for assigned accounts, ensuring adherence to contract terms in collaboration with Sales

• Implement corrective measures when KPIs deviate from targets, leading cross-functional teams to ensure success

• Apply your business mindset and client & market understanding to grow the partnership through driving innovation in existing products and/or development of follow-on products that align with the client’s needs

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Medicine, or Engineering; further education in Product Management, Project Management or Business Administration

• Experience in liquid handling and robotics, clinical diagnostics, and/or life sciences

• Experience working with customers/partners in a B2B setting, OEM experience is a plus

• Experience managing cross-functional teams and/or complex products (HW, SW, services)

• Expertise in negotiating complex contracts, particularly in development and supply agreements is a plus

• Proficiency in English; German would be an asset.

• High natural authority, power of persuasion, and ability to handle rapidly changing market and customer situations

• Strong communication skills, experience in communication to executives is a plus

• Team-oriented, customer-focused, persistent, reliable, and self-motivated

• Willingness to travel worldwide (10–20%)

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

Are you ready to make a real impact by transforming data into actionable business strategies? At Tecan, we are looking for a Strategy & Sales Excellence Specialist with a consulting background to join our EMEA Commercial Operations team.

Strategy & Sales Excellence Specialist EMEA (80- 100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this influential role, you will be at the heart of our EMEA Commercial Operations, acting as a trusted advisor and analytical partner to senior leaders. You will dive deep into sales and market data, uncovering insights that drive strategic decisions and commercial excellence. By combining your consulting mindset with advanced analytical skills, you will transform complex information into clear, actionable recommendations and compelling stories that support business growth across Europe. Your ability to communicate effectively and collaborate across functions will empower teams to make fact-based decisions and achieve ambitious goals.

Responsibilities

• Collect, structure, and analyze sales funnel and performance data to provide transparency and actionable insights for the EMEA region.

• Translate complex data into clear business messages, dashboards, and high-quality presentations for executive stakeholders.

• Prepare regular business updates, executive summaries, and performance reviews, highlighting key risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.

• Drive the European forecast process by analyzing CRM funnel data, tracking specific opportunities as needed, consolidating all opportunity data into a comprehension “forecast”, and monitoring forecast accuracy.

• Track and report on sales opportunities, market trends, and competitor insights to inform commercial strategies.

• Act as a consulting-style sparring partner for commercial leaders, helping to frame business questions, structure analysis, and prepare recommendations.

• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to drive strategic initiatives and support commercial performance.

• Develop and maintain dashboards, trackers, and reporting templates for commercial leadership and regional performance reviews.

• Support business reviews by creating structured storylines around performance and strategic initiatives.

• Assist regional teams with ad-hoc analysis, business cases, and account deep-dives to identify growth opportunities and risks.

Your background

We’re looking for more than just technical skills—we value curiosity, analytical thinking, and the ability to communicate insights with impact.

• 2–3 years of professional experience in consulting, business research, market intelligence, or commercial performance analysis.

• Degree in Business, Science or Engineering

• Proven ability to break down complex problems, structure analysis, and deliver clear recommendations.

• Advanced skills in Excel are a must. Experience with other data analysis tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Business Warehouse) is a plus.

• Experience preparing high-quality PowerPoint presentations and executive summaries for senior audiences.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; German or other languages are a plus.

• Confident, collaborative, and proactive mindset with strong business acumen.

• Ability to influence and lead across organizational boundaries, and work effectively in cross-functional teams.

• Willingness to travel internationally as required.

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Associate Product Manager (100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As an Associate Product Manager, you’ll work closely with our Product Management team to support one of Tecan’s Liquid Handling platforms. This is a great opportunity to learn, grow, and make a real impact—even if you’re just starting out. We’re looking for someone who is eager, honest, and ready to go the extra mile.

Responsibilities

• Support market research and help gather insights about customer needs

• Work closely with your team and other departments to achieve shared goals

• Help promote Tecan products and initiatives

• Assist in developing strategies and marketing plans for our products

• Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliver them on time

• Track product performance and help with pricing analysis

• Support the product life cycle from idea to launch and beyond

• Join product development meetings and contribute your perspective

Your background

We value your attitude and potential as much as your experience. If you’re motivated, open to learning, and ready to take on new challenges, we want to hear from you!

• You have a degree (or are about to graduate) in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering, a technical/scientific field, or similar experience

• You’re independent, can prioritize your work, and are not afraid to ask questions

• You’re a team player who fits well with others and communicates honestly

• You’re a self-starter who is eager to learn

• You’re open, curious, and want to make a difference

• You deliver on your commitments

• You’re comfortable communicating and presenting in English (German or other languages are a plus)

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Make a real impact on the world of tomorrow

• Work in an international, diverse, and supportive environment

• Grow your career with us—your development matters

• Be empowered by our strong company culture

• Enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

Ti sei mai chiesto come le tue capacità e il tuo background unico possano influenzare il mondo di domani? Entra a far parte del nostro team di produzione e usa il talento e la passione che ti definiscono.

Ingegnere di produzione (80-100%)

Männedorf, Svizzera

Il tuo contributo

In questo ruolo versatile, avrai la responsabilità tecnica di un portafoglio di prodotti durante la gestione del ciclo di vita. Con la tua conoscenza tecnica e passione per i sistemi complessi, nonché la tua spinta al miglioramento costante, contribuisci in modo significativo a garantire che i nostri prodotti soddisfino sempre i più elevati requisiti dei clienti. Fungono da interfaccia al centro tra produzione interna/esterna, ricerca e sviluppo, approvvigionamento, gestione del prodotto e garanzia della qualità.

• Supporto tecnico dei prodotti assegnati dal rilascio della serie pilota al Phase Out.

• Avviare e implementare modifiche meccaniche, elettroniche o software insieme a un team di esperti in materia.

• Analisi degli errori e implementazione di misure di miglioramento

• Pianificazione e gestione delle validazioni dei processi nella nostra produzione o presso i fornitori.

• Sviluppo e pianificazione delle apparecchiature di produzione e di collaudo necessarie

• Supporto al processo e controllo delle linee produttive assegnate attraverso il monitoraggio delle figure chiave

• Garantire la qualità dei dati nel sistema ERP per un'elaborazione fluida degli ordini

• Partecipazione a progetti LCM per incorporare gli aspetti tecnologici di produzione

• Supportare la garanzia della qualità nelle questioni tecniche

• Supportare gli acquisti con domande tecniche e attività con fornitori e subfornitori

Il tuo profilo

• Formazione completata come ingegnere elettronico o ingegnere meccatronico, possibilmente con ulteriore formazione (ad es. tecnico HF o equivalente)

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nella produzione, idealmente nell'industria della tecnologia medica, biofarmaceutica, dell'automazione, automobilistica o aeronautica

• Ottima conoscenza delle tecnologie di produzione, progettazione e logistica

• Esperienza professionale nei settori regolamentati della tecnologia medica/biofarmaceutica, dell'automazione, automobilistico e/o aeronautico

• Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese, sia parlata che scritta

• Cerchiamo oltre alle competenze tecniche anche una personalità che si distingua per la proattività e la spinta al miglioramento costante.

Cosa rende unico lavorare in Tecan?

· La possibilità di fare la differenza e contribuire a plasmare il mondo di domani

· Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

· Interessanti opportunità di carriera

· Cultura aziendale forte e unica

· Retribuzioni interessanti e benefici sociali

Entra a far parte di Tecan, certificato Great Place to Work! Puoi scoprire di più sulla nostra certificazione qui. Ottimo posto dove lavorare.

Aspettiamo con ansia la tua candidatura online. Per la tua candidatura abbiamo bisogno solo del tuo CV (senza foto e senza lettera di motivazione, certificati e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Possiamo prendere in considerazione solo le candidature che soddisfano le nostre esigenze.

Il nostro scopo.

In Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo consentendo ai nostri clienti di ampliare l’innovazione sanitaria a livello globale, dalle scienze della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dalla fase iniziale dell'innovazione fino all'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precisi, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimani unico e fallo contare.

I nostri valori - fiducia, standard più elevati e ambizione - sono i pilastri della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e stimolante in cui le nostre risorse più rare, i nostri dipendenti unici, possano crescere e mettere al lavoro la loro passione e il loro talento.

Ingénieur de Production (80-100%)

Männedorf, Suisse

Votre contribution

Dans ce rôle polyvalent, vous aurez la responsabilité technique d'un portefeuille de produits pendant la gestion du cycle de vie. Grâce à votre compréhension technique et votre passion pour les systèmes complexes ainsi que votre volonté d'amélioration constante, vous contribuez de manière significative à ce que nos produits répondent toujours aux exigences les plus élevées des clients. Ils agissent comme une interface au centre entre la production interne/externe, la recherche et le développement, les achats, la gestion des produits et l'assurance qualité.

• Support technique des produits assignés depuis la sortie de la série pilote jusqu'à l'élimination progressive.

• Initier et mettre en œuvre des modifications mécaniques, électroniques ou logicielles avec une équipe d'experts en la matière.

• Analyse des erreurs et mise en œuvre de mesures d'amélioration

• Planification et gestion des validations de processus dans notre production ou chez les fournisseurs.

• Développement et planification des équipements de production et de test requis

• Support des processus et contrôle des lignes de production assignées par le suivi des chiffres clés

• Assurer la qualité des données dans le système ERP pour un traitement fluide des commandes

• Participation aux projets LCM pour intégrer les aspects technologiques de production

• Soutenir l'assurance qualité dans les problèmes techniques

• Soutenir les achats avec des questions techniques et des activités avec les fournisseurs et sous-fournisseurs

Votre profil

• Formation complétée en tant qu'ingénieur électronicien ou ingénieur mécatronique, idéalement avec une formation complémentaire (par exemple technicien HF ou comparable)

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente en production, idéalement dans les industries de la technologie médicale, biopharmaceutique, de l'automatisation, de l'automobile ou de l'aviation.

• Très bonne connaissance de la technologie de production, de la conception et de la logistique

• Expérience professionnelle dans les secteurs réglementés de la technologie médicale/biopharmaceutique, de l'automatisation, de l'automobile et/ou de l'aviation.

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais, parlés et écrits

• Au-delà de l'expertise technique, nous recherchons également une personnalité qui se démarque par des actions proactives et une volonté d'amélioration constante.

Qu’est-ce qui rend le travail chez Tecan unique ?

· La chance de faire une différence et de contribuer à façonner le monde de demain

· Travailler dans un environnement international et diversifié

· Des opportunités de carrière passionnantes

· Culture d'entreprise forte et unique

· Rémunération et avantages sociaux attractifs

Chez Tecan, nous sommes déterminés à améliorer la vie et la santé des gens. Restez unique et faites en sorte que cela compte.

Männedorf, Schweiz

• Sicherstellen der Datenqualität im ERP System für eine reibungslose Auftragsabwicklung

• Mitarbeit in LCM-Projekten, um die produktionstechnischen Aspekte einzubringen

• Unterstützung der Qualitätssicherung in technischen Fragen

• Unterstützung des Einkaufs bei technischen Fragen und Aktivitäten mit Lieferanten und Sub-Lieferanten

Dein Profil

• Motivation und Eigenverantwortung, um unsere Produkte und Produktionsprozesse stetig zu verbessern.

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Produktionstechnik, -gestaltung und Logistik

• Berufserfahrung in der regulierten Medizintechnik-/Bio-Pharma, Automatisierungs-, Automobil- und/oder Aviatik-Industrie

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ti sei mai chiesto come le tue capacità e il tuo background unico possano influenzare il mondo di domani? Entra a far parte del nostro team di produzione e usa il talento e la passione che ti definiscono.

Ingegnere di produzione (100%)

Männedorf, Svizzera

Il tuo contributo

In questo ruolo versatile, avrai la responsabilità tecnica di un portafoglio di prodotti durante la gestione del ciclo di vita. Con la tua conoscenza tecnica e passione per i sistemi complessi, nonché la tua spinta al miglioramento costante, contribuisci in modo significativo a garantire che i nostri prodotti soddisfino sempre i più elevati requisiti dei clienti. Fungono da interfaccia al centro tra produzione interna/esterna, ricerca e sviluppo, approvvigionamento, gestione del prodotto e garanzia della qualità.

• Definizione e sviluppo dei processi MES (Manufacturing Execution System).

• Implementazione end-to-end e ottimizzazione continua del MES

• Responsabilità della gestione di progetti e sottoprogetti per implementazioni e implementazioni MES complesse

• Supporto tecnico dei prodotti assegnati dal rilascio della serie pilota al Phase Out.

• Avviare e implementare modifiche meccaniche, elettroniche o software insieme a un team di esperti in materia.

• Analisi degli errori e implementazione di misure di miglioramento

• Pianificazione e gestione delle validazioni dei processi nella nostra produzione o presso i fornitori.

• Sviluppo e pianificazione delle apparecchiature di produzione e di collaudo necessarie

• Supporto al processo e controllo delle linee produttive assegnate attraverso il monitoraggio delle figure chiave

• Garantire la qualità dei dati nel sistema ERP per un'elaborazione fluida degli ordini

• Partecipazione a progetti LCM per incorporare gli aspetti tecnologici di produzione

• Supportare la garanzia della qualità nelle questioni tecniche

• Supportare gli acquisti con domande tecniche e attività con fornitori e subfornitori

Il tuo profilo

• Motivazione e responsabilità personale per migliorare continuamente i nostri prodotti e processi produttivi.

• Laurea in ingegneria (ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria dei sistemi o ingegneria della produzione) o tecnico in ingegneria elettrica HF o ingegneria meccanica con almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale

• Ottima conoscenza delle tecnologie di produzione, progettazione e logistica

• Esperienza professionale nei settori regolamentati della tecnologia medica/biofarmaceutica, dell'automazione, automobilistico e/o aeronautico

• Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese, sia parlata che scritta

• Cerchiamo oltre alle competenze tecniche anche una personalità che si distingua per la proattività e la spinta al miglioramento costante.

Cosa rende unico lavorare in Tecan?

· La possibilità di fare la differenza e contribuire a plasmare il mondo di domani

· Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

· Interessanti opportunità di carriera

· Cultura aziendale forte e unica

· Retribuzioni interessanti e benefici sociali

Entra a far parte di Tecan, certificato Great Place to Work! Puoi scoprire di più sulla nostra certificazione qui. Ottimo posto dove lavorare.

Aspettiamo con ansia la tua candidatura online. Per la tua candidatura abbiamo bisogno solo del tuo CV (senza foto e senza lettera di motivazione, certificati e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Possiamo prendere in considerazione solo le candidature che soddisfano le nostre esigenze.

Il nostro scopo.

In Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo consentendo ai nostri clienti di ampliare l’innovazione sanitaria a livello globale, dalle scienze della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dalla fase iniziale dell'innovazione fino all'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precisi, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimani unico e fallo contare.

I nostri valori - fiducia, standard più elevati e ambizione - sono i pilastri della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e stimolante in cui le nostre risorse più rare, i nostri dipendenti unici, possano crescere e mettere al lavoro la loro passione e il loro talento.

Requisiti

- Hai una buona conoscenza dell'utilizzo dei comuni software di illustrazione 3D (Creo Illustrate, 3DViaComposer o software comparabile).

Offriamo
