Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e stimolante in cui le nostre risorse più rare, i nostri dipendenti unici, possano crescere e mettere al lavoro la loro passione e il loro talento.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Robotics team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior Embedded Software Engineer (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will design, implement, and test embedded software modules and solutions for liquid handling and robotic applications. You will be involved in planning and developing software concepts, ensuring software quality, and troubleshooting. Your role will require interdisciplinary cooperation with electronics, software, and mechanics teams.

Responsibilities

• Plan, develop, and implement software concepts using modern C++ for embedded systems.

• Ensure software quality by applying latest tools and through systematic testing and error correction.

• Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to integrate software

• Evaluate new tools and methods and define coding standards and guidelines.

• Ensure compliance with processes, SOPs, and regulatory standards (IEC 62304, ISO 13485).

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical discipline (e.g. Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering)

• Strong passion for embedded software engineering

• At least 5 years of professional experience with state-of-the-art software development using modern C++, preferably C++20

• Experience with advanced template metaprogramming

• Experience working with real-time operating systems (RTOS), preferably POSIX-based operating systems

• Experience with communication interfaces and protocols such as SPI, CAN and QUIC and Ethernet-based protocols (e.g. UDP)

• Familiarity with technologies and tools such as Protobuf, CMake, Tracealyzer and Docker is a plus

• Experience in sensing technologies and motor control systems is a plus

• Strong sense of ownership with the motivation to take responsibility and drive projects to successful completion

• Good written and spoken English skills; German language skills is a plus

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

descriptionByLocale.en:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Robotics team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior Embedded Software Engineer (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will design, implement, and test embedded software modules and solutions for liquid handling and robotic applications. You will be involved in planning and developing software concepts, ensuring software quality, and troubleshooting. Your role will require interdisciplinary cooperation with electronics, software, and mechanics teams.

Responsibilities

• Plan, develop, and implement software concepts using modern C++ for embedded systems.

• Ensure software quality by applying latest tools and through systematic testing and error correction.

• Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to integrate software

• Evaluate new tools and methods and define coding standards and guidelines.

• Ensure compliance with processes, SOPs, and regulatory standards (IEC 62304, ISO 13485).

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical discipline (e.g. Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering)

• Strong passion for embedded software engineering

• At least 5 years of professional experience with state-of-the-art software development using modern C++, preferably C++20

• Experience with advanced template metaprogramming

• Experience working with real-time operating systems (RTOS), preferably POSIX-based operating systems

• Experience with communication interfaces and protocols such as SPI, CAN and QUIC and Ethernet-based protocols (e.g. UDP)

• Familiarity with technologies and tools such as Protobuf, CMake, Tracealyzer and Docker is a plus

• Experience in sensing technologies and motor control systems is a plus

• Strong sense of ownership with the motivation to take responsibility and drive projects to successful completion

• Good written and spoken English skills; German language skills is a plus

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our R&D team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Project Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this pivotal role, you will take the lead on development projects from end to end, ensuring timely delivery, budget compliance, and achievement of key performance objectives. You will have full ownership and accountability for mid-sized projects, including internal initiatives and customer specific projects.

Responsibilities

• Defining and building project teams with the right cross-functional mix of professional skills.

• Managing the planning, staffing, and execution of development projects for lab automation and clinical diagnostics according to applicable development processes.

• Planning, monitoring, and reporting on complex projects, coordinating interfaces with related projects.

• Ensuring proactive and proper communication within the organization and with stakeholders, including management board members.

• Demonstrating clear leadership within the organization towards all management levels.

• Coordinating team members located across multiple locations.

• Through leadership and methodological competence, ensure efficient implementation and adherence to processes, guidelines, and regulations, such as: ISO 13485, IEC 61010, and the machinery directive (2006/42/EC).

• Lead and coordinate cross-functional team activities across departments to ensure successful delivery of project goals — from feasibility studies and product development through design transfer and industrialization.

• Drive effective stakeholder management and proactively resolve conflicts within the project team and across stakeholders.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• BSc or MSc in a technical degree in a technical field, preferably in engineering, life sciences, mechanical or electrical disciplines.

• A PhD in Life Sciences, along with project management education, PMP or similar certifications, and training in change management and leadership, will set you apart.

• At least 3 years of experience in project management, preferably in the development of complex instruments or automated solutions for diagnostic applications.

• Experience in product management and business administration is a bonus.

• Fluent in English; additional languages (German and others) are a plus.

• Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Proven experience in leading highly regulated product development projects, with a focus on automation, assay development, and agile project management.

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Ti sei mai chiesto come le tue abilità e il tuo background unico potrebbero influenzare il mondo di domani? Unisciti al nostro team R&D e porta la tua passione e talento al lavoro.

Project Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zurigo

Il tuo contributo

In questo ruolo fondamentale, si prenderanno il vantaggio di progetti di sviluppo da fine a fine, garantendo la consegna tempestiva, la conformità del bilancio e il raggiungimento di obiettivi di prestazioni chiave. Avrete piena proprietà e responsabilità per progetti di medie dimensioni, tra cui iniziative interne e progetti specifici per i clienti.

responsabilità

• Definire e costruire team di progetto con il giusto mix interfunzionale di competenze professionali.

• Gestire la pianificazione, il personale e l'esecuzione di progetti di sviluppo per l'automazione del laboratorio e la diagnostica clinica secondo i processi di sviluppo applicabili.

• Pianificazione, monitoraggio e reporting su progetti complessi, coordinando le interfacce con progetti correlati.

• Garantire una comunicazione proattiva e corretta all'interno dell'organizzazione e con gli stakeholder, compresi i membri del consiglio di amministrazione.

• Dimostrare una chiara leadership all'interno dell'organizzazione verso tutti i livelli di gestione.

• Coordinare i membri del team situati in più posizioni.

• Attraverso la leadership e la competenza metodologica, garantire l'implementazione e l'adesione efficienti a processi, linee guida e regolamenti, come: ISO 13485, IEC 61010 e la direttiva sulle macchine (2006/42/CE).

• Guidare e coordinare le attività di team interfunzionali in tutti i reparti per garantire la consegna di obiettivi di progetto, dagli studi di fattibilità e dallo sviluppo dei prodotti attraverso il trasferimento di progettazione e l'industrializzazione.

• Guidare la gestione efficace delle parti interessate e risolvere proattivamente i conflitti all'interno del team di progetto e tra le parti interessate.

Il tuo sfondo

Non siamo solo alla ricerca di abilità dure: Stiamo cercando persone che portano la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

• BSc o MSc in grado tecnico in un campo tecnico, preferibilmente in ingegneria, scienze della vita, discipline meccaniche o elettriche.

• Un PhD in Scienze della Vita, insieme con l'istruzione di gestione del progetto, PMP o certificazioni simili, e la formazione nella gestione dei cambiamenti e la leadership, vi farà a pezzi.

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nella gestione del progetto, preferibilmente nello sviluppo di strumenti complessi o soluzioni automatizzate per applicazioni diagnostiche.

• L'esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti e nell'amministrazione aziendale è un bonus.

• Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive (tedesco e altri) sono un plus.

• Ottima capacitÃ di presentazione e comunicazione, con la capacitÃ di trasmettere in modo efficace soluzioni tecniche sia al pubblico tecnico che non tecnico

• Esperienza dimostrata nei principali progetti di sviluppo di prodotti altamente regolamentati, con un focus sull'automazione, lo sviluppo di saggi e la gestione agile del progetto.

W hat fa lavorare a Tecan unico

La possibilità di farlo contare e di avere un impatto sul mondo di domani

• Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

• La possibilità di crescere la tua carriera all'interno dell'azienda

• Sentirsi potenziato dalla nostra cultura aziendale forte e unica

• Pacchetto completo di compensazione e benefici

Unisciti a Tecan, un ottimo posto per lavorare! Leggi la nostra recente certificazione da Great Place a Work .

Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Si prega di inviare il CV o il curriculum (w/o foto e w/o lettera di presentazione, lettere di riferimento e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - fiducia, elevati standard e ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

Haben Sie sich jemals gefragt, wie Ihre Fähigkeiten und Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen könnten? Treten Sie unserem R & D-Team bei und bringen Sie Ihre Leidenschaft und Ihr Talent zur Arbeit.

Projektmanager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Ihr Beitrag

In dieser zentralen Rolle übernehmen Sie die Führung bei Entwicklungsprojekten von Ende zu Ende und gewährleisten eine rechtzeitige Lieferung, die Einhaltung des Budgets und die Erreichung der wichtigsten Leistungsziele. Sie haben die volle Verantwortung für mittelgroße Projekte, einschließlich interner Initiativen und kundenspezifischer Projekte.

Zuständigkeiten

• Definieren und Aufbauen von Projektteams mit dem richtigen funktionsübergreifenden Mix professioneller Kompetenzen.

• Leitung der Planung, Personalbesetzung und Durchführung von Entwicklungsprojekten für Laborautomation und klinische Diagnostik gemäß den anwendbaren Entwicklungsprozessen.

• Planung, Überwachung und Berichterstattung über komplexe Projekte, Koordination der Schnittstellen mit verwandten Projekten.

• Sicherstellung einer proaktiven und ordnungsgemäßen Kommunikation innerhalb der Organisation und mit Stakeholdern, einschließlich Vorstandsmitgliedern.

• Nachweis einer klaren Führung innerhalb der Organisation gegenüber allen Managementebenen.

• Koordinierende Teammitglieder an mehreren Standorten.

• Durch Führungs- und Methodenkompetenz sorgen Sie für eine effiziente Umsetzung und Einhaltung von Prozessen, Richtlinien und Vorschriften wie ISO 13485, IEC 61010 und der Maschinenrichtlinie (2006/42/EG).

• Führen und koordinieren Sie abteilungsübergreifend funktionsübergreifende Teamaktivitäten, um die erfolgreiche Umsetzung der Projektziele sicherzustellen – von Machbarkeitsstudien und Produktentwicklung bis hin zu Designtransfer und Industrialisierung.

• Führen Sie ein effektives Stakeholder-Management und lösen Sie proaktiv Konflikte innerhalb des Projektteams und zwischen den Stakeholdern.

Dein Hintergrund

Wir suchen nicht nur nach Hard Skills: Wir suchen Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent in die Arbeit bringen.

• BSc oder MSc in einem technischen Grad in einem technischen Bereich, vorzugsweise in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Biowissenschaften, mechanischen oder elektrischen Disziplinen.

• Ein PhD in Life Sciences, zusammen mit Projektmanagement-Ausbildung, PMP oder ähnlichen Zertifizierungen und Ausbildung in Change Management und Führung, werden Sie auszeichnen.

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, vorzugsweise in der Entwicklung komplexer Instrumente oder automatisierter Lösungen für diagnostische Anwendungen.

• Erfahrung im Produktmanagement und in der Betriebswirtschaft ist ein Bonus.

• Fließend Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen (Deutsch und andere) sind ein Plus.

• Hervorragende Präsentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen sowohl für technische als auch für nicht-technische Zielgruppen effektiv zu vermitteln

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung von stark regulierten Produktentwicklungsprojekten mit Fokus auf Automatisierung, Assay-Entwicklung und agilem Projektmanagement.

W Hat macht das Arbeiten bei Tecan einzigartig

Die Chance, dass es zählt und einen Einfluss auf die Welt von morgen hat

• Arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Umfeld

• Die Chance, Ihre Karriere innerhalb des Unternehmens zu erweitern

• Fühlen Sie sich durch unsere starke und einzigartige Unternehmenskultur gestärkt

• Umfassendes Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket

Treten Sie Tecan bei, einem großartigen Ort zum Arbeiten! Lesen Sie mehr über unsere jüngste Zertifizierung von Great Place to Work .

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung online. Bitte reichen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf oder Lebenslauf ein (mit Bild und Anschreiben, Referenzschreiben und Diplomen sind optional).

Unser Ziel.

Bei Tecan sind wir bestrebt, das Leben und die Gesundheit der Menschen zu verbessern. Wir tun dies, indem wir unsere Kunden in die Lage versetzen, Gesundheitsinnovationen weltweit von der Biowissenschaft bis zur Klinik zu skalieren. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Kunden von der Frühphase der Innovation bis zur Projektumsetzung und darüber hinaus zusammen. Wir liefern die Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Lösungen, die Laborprozesse und medizinische Verfahren präzise, reproduzierbar und konform machen.

Bleib einzigartig und lass es zählen.

Unsere Werte - Vertrauen, höchste Standards und Ehrgeiz - sind die Eckpfeiler unseres Geschäfts und bilden den Rahmen für die Kultur von Tecan. Wir fördern ein positives und ermächtigendes Umfeld, in dem unsere seltensten Vermögenswerte, unsere einzigartigen Mitarbeiter, wachsen und ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent einbringen können.

Gestionnaire de projet (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Votre contribution

Dans ce rôle central, vous dirigerez les projets de développement de bout en bout, assurant l'exécution en temps opportun, la conformité budgétaire et la réalisation des principaux objectifs de rendement. Vous aurez la pleine propriété et la responsabilité pour les projets de taille moyenne, y compris les initiatives internes et les projets spécifiques à la clientèle.

Responsabilités

• Définir et construire des équipes de projet avec le bon mélange de compétences professionnelles.

• Gérer la planification, la dotation et l'exécution des projets de développement pour l'automatisation des laboratoires et le diagnostic clinique selon les processus de développement applicables.

• Planification, suivi et rapports sur les projets complexes, coordination des interfaces avec les projets connexes.

• Assurer une communication proactive et adéquate au sein de l'organisation et avec les intervenants, y compris les membres du conseil de gestion.

• Démontrer un leadership clair au sein de l'organisation à tous les niveaux de gestion.

• Les membres de l'équipe de coordination se trouvent à plusieurs endroits.

• Grâce à des compétences en matière de leadership et de méthodologie, assurer une mise en œuvre et un respect efficaces des processus, des lignes directrices et des règlements, tels que la norme ISO 13485, la norme CEI 61010 et la directive sur les machines (2006/42/CE).

• Diriger et coordonner les activités des équipes interfonctionnelles dans tous les ministères afin d'assurer la réalisation des objectifs du projet, depuis les études de faisabilité et la mise au point de produits jusqu'au transfert de conception et à l'industrialisation.

Vos antécédents

• Un doctorat en sciences de la vie, ainsi qu'une formation en gestion de projet, PMP ou certifications similaires, et une formation en gestion du changement et en leadership, vous sépareront.

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet, de préférence dans le développement d'instruments complexes ou de solutions automatisées pour les applications diagnostiques.

• L'expérience en gestion de produits et en administration des affaires est un bonus.

• Fluent en anglais; langues supplémentaires (allemand et autres) sont un plus.

• Excellente capacité de présentation et de communication, avec la capacité de transmettre efficacement des solutions techniques aux publics techniques et non techniques

• Expérience éprouvée dans la conduite de projets de développement de produits hautement réglementés, en mettant l'accent sur l'automatisation, le développement de tests et la gestion de projets agiles.

W chapeau fait travailler à Tecan unique

La chance de le faire compter et d'avoir un impact sur le monde de demain

• Travailler dans un environnement international et diversifié

• La chance de développer votre carrière au sein de l'entreprise

• Se sentir autonomisé par notre culture d'entreprise forte et unique

• Ensemble complet de rémunération et de prestations

Rejoignez Tecan, un endroit idéal pour travailler ! Lisez notre récente certification de Great Place to Work .

Notre but.

Chez Tecan, nous sommes déterminés à améliorer la vie et la santé des gens. Nous le faisons en donnant à nos clients les moyens d'étendre l'innovation en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, depuis les sciences de la vie jusqu'à la clinique. jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our EHS Office team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Product Environmental Compliance Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this important and hands-on role, you will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for product environmental compliance at Tecan, responsible for ensuring global compliance with all relevant product environmental and sustainability regulations. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will operationally execute compliance processes and lead multiple complex regulatory projects across various Tecan sites. Your expertise will help shape Tecan’s approach to regulated substances in articles, extended producer responsibility, and the implementation of effective compliance strategies, all within a dynamic environment where regulatory developments are proactively monitored and integrated into our compliance efforts.

Responsibilities

• Execute Tecan’s global SOPs for compliance with regulated substances in articles and extend producer responsibility (RoHS, REACH, POP, TSCA, Conflict Minerals, WEEE, batteries, packaging) including collection of supplier declarations and preparation of compliance documentation

• Lead and implement multiple complex regulatory projects, ensuring efficient prioritization and execution (e.g. RoHS 6b, PFAS)

• Manage the global product environmental compliance database, including compliance software and data maintenance.

• Secure compliance with local extended producer responsibility obligations (WEEE, packaging, batteries), including registrations and reporting.

• Contribute to surveillance and analysis of the global regulatory landscape, supporting the development of long-term compliance strategies.

• Support technical evaluation of new regulations, early risk identification, and design of mitigation strategies.

• Act as a subject matter expert for senior leaders and cross-functional teams, answering internal and external queries.

• Provide training on product environmental compliance topics and perform internal/intra-company audits.

• Maintain clear compliance status reporting and coordinate issuing of compliance certificates and Critical Mineral reporting.

• Possibility to represent Tecan in trade associations, ensuring alignment with industry standards.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Higher education degree in a scientific or engineering discipline; chemical background is a plus.

• 5+ years of experience in product stewardship or product environmental regulations, preferably in MedTech.

• Experience implementing complex product environmental requirements.

• Familiarity with product environmental regulations and standards (RoHS, REACH, POP, PFAS, WEEE, Batteries, Packaging).

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and German.

• Strong communicator able to explain the “why” behind regulations to diverse audiences.

• Project management experience in a matrix organization.

• Experience in material management, especially SAP.

• Pragmatic, solution-driven working style with a sense of urgency and a strong track record of meeting deadlines.

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our EHS Office team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Product Environmental Compliance Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this important and hands-on role, you will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for product environmental compliance at Tecan, responsible for ensuring global compliance with all relevant product environmental and sustainability regulations. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will operationally execute compliance processes and lead multiple complex regulatory projects across various Tecan sites. Your expertise will help shape Tecan’s approach to regulated substances in articles, extended producer responsibility, and the implementation of effective compliance strategies, all within a dynamic environment where regulatory developments are proactively monitored and integrated into our compliance efforts.

Responsibilities

• Execute Tecan’s global SOPs for compliance with regulated substances in articles and extend producer responsibility (RoHS, REACH, POP, TSCA, Conflict Minerals, WEEE, batteries, packaging) including collection of supplier declarations and preparation of compliance documentation

• Lead and implement multiple complex regulatory projects, ensuring efficient prioritization and execution (e.g. RoHS 6b, PFAS)

• Manage the global product environmental compliance database, including compliance software and data maintenance.

• Secure compliance with local extended producer responsibility obligations (WEEE, packaging, batteries), including registrations and reporting.

• Contribute to surveillance and analysis of the global regulatory landscape, supporting the development of long-term compliance strategies.

• Support technical evaluation of new regulations, early risk identification, and design of mitigation strategies.

• Act as a subject matter expert for senior leaders and cross-functional teams, answering internal and external queries.

• Provide training on product environmental compliance topics and perform internal/intra-company audits.

• Maintain clear compliance status reporting and coordinate issuing of compliance certificates and Critical Mineral reporting.

• Possibility to represent Tecan in trade associations, ensuring alignment with industry standards.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Higher education degree in a scientific or engineering discipline; chemical background is a plus.

• 5+ years of experience in product stewardship or product environmental regulations, preferably in MedTech.

• Experience implementing complex product environmental requirements.

• Familiarity with product environmental regulations and standards (RoHS, REACH, POP, PFAS, WEEE, Batteries, Packaging).

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and German.

• Strong communicator able to explain the “why” behind regulations to diverse audiences.

• Project management experience in a matrix organization.

• Experience in material management, especially SAP.

• Pragmatic, solution-driven working style with a sense of urgency and a strong track record of meeting deadlines.

• Ability to prioritise effectively.

• Willingness to travel internationally (<10%).

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Partnering Business department and bring your passion and talent to work.

(Associate) Customer Product Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Customer Product Manager, you will be the primary liaison for coordinating and driving our Partnering Business partner products — with a special focus on customized solutions based on platform products— with all internal and external stakeholders. You will support the Partnering Business sales teams in contractual and pricing negotiations, outline value propositions, and drive alignment sessions. Your role involves managing trade-offs between client business demands, product life cycle stages, and Tecan business needs to create win/win positions. You will also contribute to the development of the Customer Product Management team with entrepreneurial thinking and market insights.

Responsibilities

• Manage and oversee all day-to-day lifecycle and operational aspects for assigned projects and products, including business and quality review meetings, regular conference calls, and product change management.

• Drive customer satisfaction and support Tecan’s Partnering Business marketing, financial, and growth objectives through operational excellence and proactive life cycle management.

• Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and maintain relevant product documentation.

• Monitor and manage product forecasting, orders, and deliveries, and drive necessary actions in alignment with key stakeholders.

• Lead the Product Care Team, manage product-related KPIs, and ensure on-time delivery of agreed items.

• Support the sales organization in preparing and negotiating contracts, and monitor contract expirations and obligations.

• Provide cross-functional guidance and support for the teams, and spot and identify client trends.

• Play a key role in efficiently managing the lifecycle of platform-based products by applying established processes and driving continuous improvement initiatives

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Medicine, or Engineering, with further education in Product Management or Business Administration.

• Experience in liquid handling and robotics, clinical diagnostics, and/or life science business.

• Experience in highly complex system development, supporting system sales activities, and product/lifecycle management.

• Proficiency in English; German would be an asset.

• Strong negotiation skills and experience in executing complex contracts.

• High natural authority, power of persuasion, and ability to handle rapidly changing market and customer situations.

• Team-oriented, entrepreneurial thinking, persistent, reliable, and self-motivated.

• Willingness to travel worldwide (5-10%).

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Global Distributors team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Regional Channel Sales & Distributors Manager EMEA (100%)

Männedorf, Switzerland (with extensive travel across EMEA)

Your contribution

As the Regional Channel Sales & Distributors Manager EMEA, you will play a key role in driving Tecan’s growth across the EMEA region. You will be responsible for building and managing a high-performing distributor network, ensuring our partners are empowered to deliver advanced laboratory automation solutions to customers in life sciences, applied markets, and clinical diagnostics. By acting as a strategic link between market needs and Tecan’s internal teams, you will help shape business development and product innovation. Your efforts will ensure the successful positioning and adoption of complex technical solutions, while fostering strong, self-sufficient distributor relationships that support Tecan’s reputation for excellence and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

• Lead the recruitment, onboarding, and ongoing performance management of distributor partners across EMEA.

• Develop and execute strategic business plans with each distributor, ensuring alignment with Tecan’s growth objectives.

• Own the full sales cycle—from opportunity generation to project delivery—acting as the primary interface between distribution partners and internal stakeholders.

• Support distributors in customer engagement, including joint visits, presentations, and negotiations.

• Monitor distributor performance, implement corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement of sales performance and profitability.

• Provide technical expertise in laboratory automation, instrument configuration, and integrated solutions.

• Deliver high-level technical presentations and participate in key customer discussions.

• Coordinate cross-functional internal stakeholders to ensure successful execution of complex and high-value projects.

• Travel extensively (50–70%) across the EMEA region to support distributor and customer needs.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in technical or natural sciences (molecular biology, physics, engineering, or related fields).

• 5+ years’ experience in life sciences, diagnostics, or laboratory automation, with hands-on exposure to complex lab instruments or automation platforms.

• Proven track record managing or working with distributor networks (ideally across EMEA).

• Strong understanding of laboratory workflows, applications, and customer environments.

• Excellent communication skills in English; French, German, or Arabic are a plus.

• Willingness and ability to travel extensively (50–70%) across the EMEA region.

• Strategic mindset, resilience, agility, and a collaborative approach to influencing without direct authority.

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.
